# NFL Daily — 2026-11-10 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Raiders trade QB Kirk Cousins back to the Vikings in a blockbuster deadline-day swap, reuniting him with coach Kevin O'Connell; Fernando Mendoza takes over as Las Vegas' starter. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444360/sources-vikings-id-qb-kirk-cousins-prime-trade-target)
- Trade deadline brings a wave of moves: Eagles send DT Jordan Davis to the Jaguars, Broncos land LB Daiyan Henley from the Chargers, and the Colts deal away WRs Keenan Allen (to the 49ers) and Josh Downs (to the Chiefs) while holding onto RB Jonathan Taylor. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444457/sources-49ers-acquire-keenan-allen-trade-colts) — also [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jonathan-taylor-stays-with-colts-nfl-trade-deadline/)
- Bengals call off an agreed trade for Eagles DE Arnold Ebiketie after realizing it would cost them a compensatory third-round pick tied to Trey Hendrickson's move to Baltimore. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-call-off-arnold-ebiketie-trade-eagles-compensatory-pick-formula-nick-korte/)
- Rams star WR Puka Nacua likely headed to injured reserve with a knee sprain and turf toe, leaving L.A. without him and Davante Adams. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7767400/2026/11/09/puka-nacua-rams-injury/)
- Cardinals take a brutal double hit: QB Gardner Minshew feared to have a torn UCL and could be out for the season, while WR Michael Wilson is already out for the year with a neck fracture. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/cardinals-gardner-minshew-feared-torn-ucl-could-out-for-season-report/) — also [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7768740/2026/11/09/michael-wilson-neck-injury-cardinals/)
- Dolphins lose captain and standout DT Zach Sieler for the season to a ruptured biceps, suffered on the opening play and played through for the full game. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50443653/source-dolphins-captain-zach-sieler-rest-season)

## Transactions
- Raiders trade QB Kirk Cousins to the Vikings for a 2027 third-round pick; Fernando Mendoza takes over as Las Vegas' starter. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444360/sources-vikings-id-qb-kirk-cousins-prime-trade-target)
- Colts trade WR Keenan Allen to the 49ers for a sixth-round pick. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444457/sources-49ers-acquire-keenan-allen-trade-colts)
- Colts trade WR Josh Downs to the Chiefs for 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445576/chiefs-trade-colts-wr-josh-downs)
- Eagles trade DT Jordan Davis to the Jaguars. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jordan-davis-traded-jaguars-acquire-former-first-round-pick-from-eagles/)
- Chargers trade LB Daiyan Henley to the Broncos for a 2027 fourth- and 2028 fifth-round pick. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445309/sources-broncos-land-daiyan-henley-trade-chargers)
- Titans trade S Amani Hooker to the Bills for a second-round pick, with a fifth coming back. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444810/bills-trade-titans-safety-amani-hooker)

## Injuries
- Rams All-Pro WR Puka Nacua (knee, turf toe) likely heading to IR, alongside Davante Adams. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7767400/2026/11/09/puka-nacua-rams-injury/)
- Cardinals QB Gardner Minshew feared to have a torn UCL and could be out for the season; Carson Beck would start in his place. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/cardinals-gardner-minshew-feared-torn-ucl-could-out-for-season-report/)
- Cardinals WR Michael Wilson out for the year with a neck fracture. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7768740/2026/11/09/michael-wilson-neck-injury-cardinals/)
- Dolphins DT Zach Sieler out for the season after rupturing his biceps on the opening play and playing through it. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50443653/source-dolphins-captain-zach-sieler-rest-season)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-10 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Jacoby Brissett, acquired via trade from the Cardinals, is expected to start at QB Monday night against the Chargers; defensive coordinator Jesse Minter said the team will keep Lamar Jackson's thumb injury updates private, including whether he needs surgery. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/kyle-hamilton-injury-update-jacoby-brissett-starting-against-chargers-monday-night-minter-lamar-jackson-injury-conversations-private)
- The Falcons signed K Jake Moody off Baltimore's practice squad, leaving the Ravens searching for a third kicker of the season with Tyler Loop still on IR. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jake-moody-falcons-ravens-signing-kicker-practice-squad) — also [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2120206001722782125)
- Kyle Hamilton (hip) is considered day-to-day after leaving Thursday's loss to the Jaguars; Minter said "everything looks fairly good" ahead of a final call after Tuesday's practice. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/kyle-hamilton-injury-update-jacoby-brissett-starting-against-chargers-monday-night-minter-lamar-jackson-injury-conversations-private)
- At the halfway point of the season, the Ravens are working with their 4th starting quarterback, 3rd starting center and 3rd kicker. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2120212623572730124)

# Rivals — 2026-11-10 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Bills (BUF) trade a second-round pick to the Titans for S Amani Hooker, who has 17 career interceptions. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444810/bills-trade-titans-safety-amani-hooker)
- Chiefs (KC) trade for Colts WR Josh Downs, giving Patrick Mahomes another target. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445576/chiefs-trade-colts-wr-josh-downs)
- Bengals (CIN) call off an agreed trade for Eagles DE Arnold Ebiketie after realizing it would cost them a compensatory third-round pick tied to Trey Hendrickson's move to Baltimore. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-call-off-arnold-ebiketie-trade-eagles-compensatory-pick-formula-nick-korte/)
- Steelers (PIT) miss out on WR trade targets Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, and the Jaguars won't move Brian Thomas Jr. either — Pittsburgh's receiver room stays as is at the deadline. [Pennlive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/pittsburgh-steelers-lose-out-on-two-more-wide-receiver-trade-targets.html)

## Transactions
- Bills (BUF) trade a second-round pick to the Titans for S Amani Hooker; a fifth-round pick comes back to Buffalo. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444810/bills-trade-titans-safety-amani-hooker)
- Chiefs (KC) trade for Colts WR Josh Downs for 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445576/chiefs-trade-colts-wr-josh-downs)

## Injuries
- Browns (CLE) QB Deshaun Watson is listed questionable for Week 10. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
